analysis_summary.notes: No compatibility changes found. This patch is additive: adds Containerfile/containerfile file extension detection to ft_from_ext dict and removes the redundant *.[dD]ockerfile autocommand pattern from filetype.vim. The *.[dD]ockerfile pattern removal is not breaking because DetectFromExt() via ft_from_ext now handles *.Dockerfile/*.dockerfile via the 'Dockerfile'/'dockerfile' dict entries. All behavior is preserved or extended; no existing detection paths are broken. Other changes (version.c patch number, Last Change date bumps, test additions) are metadata or test-only.
